prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity mobile UI concept board for the existing Geeta / Morning Ritual devotional app. Landscape board with two complete tall mobile screens side by side, not perspective, legible typography, generous gutters, understated editorial presentation. Existing palette MUST guide design: ivory #FFF9F5, peach #FEEADC, saffron #E56B27, brown-black #2C221A, forest #2A5C33, gold #F4B942. Serif main headings and clean sans-serif UI, rounded 24px cards, subtle tactile shadows, thin lucide-style icons. Use supplied images ONLY as supporting video-scene inserts: retain realistic green plant/tree, seed and soil and baked-in warm background. These are 16:9 videos, always show as landscape 16:9 scenes within mobile layouts, preserve full tree without portrait cropping. No imaginary transparent tree, no extra mascot, no watermarks. Ritual + quiz both complete advances streak one day; each task earns 10 points. First 7-day streak bonus +40 and first 30-day bonus +100. Do not invent watering button or rewards. This is design inspiration, not code. Concept 01: LIVING DAILY GOAL. Board heading "01 / A little growth, every day". Left phone HOME incomplete state: small brand Morning Ritual at top, greeting "Shubh Prabhat", subtitle "Rise with calm intention.", then beautifully designed daily goal card. Card header "Your daily growth", day badge "Day 1", points pill "20 points". Large landscape scene from reference 1 occupies card center. Below it caption "Your first leaf of intention", two task rows "Alarm-led ritual" marked "Done" and "Quiz round" saffron button "Play quiz". Status "1 of 2 complete" and two segments one active. Caption "Complete both to grow your tree." Below card an alarm tile "Tomorrow’s ritual" "6:00 AM" with toggle. Bottom dock "Home", "Gita", "Quiz", "Night". Right phone SAME HOME complete state showing reference 2 day7 plant, card heading "Your daily growth", badge "7 day streak", warm gold pill "+40 milestone bonus", both task rows done, both progress segments filled, caption "A week of showing up.", footer link "See your growth". Alarm tile and same dock. Include small understated board footer "Home card · Before and after today’s goal". Keep typography correct, screens consistent and realistic.
